description: Expanding an unknown tuple after a successful argument of try gives the dynamic value
notes: The README says try evaluates its argument expressions in order until one produces a result without any errors, so try(1, ut...) would give 1, and the spec doesn't say how an unknown value expands (native/unknowns/function-expand-unknown-tuple). hashicorp/hcl returns the dynamic value for an expanded argument that is unknown, before calling the function (FunctionCallExpr.Value in hclsyntax/expression.go), so try never runs.
